Case: Patient D is a 55-year-old Hispanic woman who is post-op day 4 status-post C3-C5 anterior cervical discectomy and fusion. Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
